P1_one_or_more_result_not_keyed._note: A node reached from two predecessors is yielded twice by + (and by *, which is + plus the start).

P2_zero_or_more_start_twice._note: A * path whose cycle leads back to the start yields the start twice (once via the cycle, once as the zero-length step).

P3_zero_or_one_start_twice._note: A ? path over a self-loop yields the start twice (zero-length step and the one step).
